title: Chapter 1316 - 3: The Shisan Of The Chaos Void

Chapter 1316 - 3: The Shisan Of The Chaos Void

Chapter 1316: Chapter 3: The Shisan of the Chaos Void

In this timeline, Lin Yuan’s strength continues to grow, quickly reaching the level where he can lock his own timeline, consolidating the past, present, and future.

And here, the majestic figure can no longer continue to observe.

The future of a Time Lord is not something ordinary time beings can glimpse.

Even before this Time Lord steps into the thirteenth level, it’s difficult to peer into.

"This is too smooth."

The majestic figure is somewhat stunned.

He randomly selected a future timeline, and the other not only smoothly stepped into the thirteenth level but also became a Time Lord?

Since becoming a being of time, the majestic figure doesn’t know how many future timelines he has glimpsed, but those related to the Time Lord are only a few dozen.

If picking a random timeline means Lin Yuan steps into the future timeline, that’s incredibly good luck.

Then, in this future timeline, Lin Yuan not only steps into the future but also becomes a Time Lord, which cannot be explained by luck alone.

Future contains infinite variables, each time node will spawn countless possibilities, even if my luck defies the heavens, how could I randomly view a timeline and just select the only one leading to becoming a Time Lord among trillions and trillions of timelines?

"Choose again."

The majestic figure collects his thoughts and immediately starts observing anew from the beginning.

But in this timeline, Lin Yuan also steps into the thirteenth level, ultimately leading to becoming a Time Lord.

"This?"

The majestic figure falls silent.

A storm begins to brew in his heart.

If it was the first timeline, it was just an incredibly good luck result.

Then in the second timeline, although the process is different, stepping into the thirteenth level, and becoming a Time Lord, there hasn’t been any change at all.

"Something’s wrong."

The majestic figure immediately starts watching more timelines.

Five, ten.

Hundreds, thousands.

In numerous timelines, there is a difference in the timing of Lin Yuan stepping into the thirteenth level and becoming a Time Lord, either sooner or later.

But the final outcome does not change.

"You guys."

The majestic figure immediately contacts the other six time beings.

These six time beings are basically in seclusion, either cultivating or observing the timelines of mysteries in dimensional spaces.

They almost have no interest in the affairs within the Chaos Void.

In the first source world, six ancestors would occasionally descend, guiding their descendants.

Yet in the Chaos Void, seven thirteenth-level beings, even if concerned with the Chaos Void, it is over long epochs, calculated in billions of Cosmic Eras.

The majestic figure’s contact doesn’t take long.

Six majestic figures descend.

"Lord Mo Xu, what brings you to us?"

A majestic figure in black armor said lazily.

Normally, the seven time beings of the Chaos Void seldom connect in this way.

Calling all six over at once?

"Could it be that time beings from another dimensional space are invading?"

Another majestic figure with a serpentine tail and human form asked.

The Chaos Void, being the top-tier dimensional space, contains great dao rules in operation, of significant reference value to time beings.

Many powerful time beings covet the Chaos Void.

"Time beings invading from other dimensional spaces? Not exactly."

The majestic figure ’Lord Mo Xu’ shook his head and then seriously said: "But it’s more unbelievable than that."

How could an invasion of time beings from another dimensional space compare to a future where it is certain to reach the thirteenth level and become a Time Lord?

"Oh?"

The six descending time beings immediately became intrigued.

"Look."

The majestic figure ’Lord Mo Xu’ flipped his right hand, and a scene unfolded, showing the figure drifting in the Desolate Void was Lin Yuan.

"Who is he?"

The majestic figure in black armor was slightly surprised, "Such a powerful physical body."

Even across the screen, he could feel Lin Yuan’s ’gravity’.

"Look at his future."

’Lord Mo Xu’ spoke tersely.

The six time beings exchanged glances and immediately began watching and peering.

As time beings, upon seeing Lin Yuan, they could establish causal relationships between each other and then view the other’s future timeline.

In moments.

The six time beings each revealed a look of disbelief.

"This?"

The time being with a human head and serpent body was shocked: "I observed dozens of timelines, and the result was all that he stepped into the thirteenth level, even becoming a Time Lord?"

"Me too."

Two or three other time beings immediately echoed.

This observation result is too unbelievable.

"I feel the same way, so in the latest timeline, I tried to stop him from breaking through to the thirteenth tier, wanting to nip it in the bud, but in the end..."

The time lifeform clad in black armor spoke incredulously, "I couldn’t do anything to the opponent?"

A dignified time lifeform, striking against a being below the thirteenth tier, could not do anything? Even on the timeline observed by it, it fought fiercely with Lin Yuan, battling into the dimensional gap.

But even at the end, it couldn’t suppress him.

"Hmm?"

’Lord Mo Xu’ was startled in his heart.

On the timeline he was watching, it was predicated on time lifeforms like himself not interfering, and Lin Yuan would almost inevitably step into the thirteenth tier.

And according to the timeline observed by the black armor, even with time lifeforms intervening, it was impossible to stop him, and they couldn’t even do anything to him.

"Let me take a look as well."

Upon hearing these words, the other time lifeforms immediately began attempting to choose a timeline to kill Lin Yuan.

"Can’t kill him."

"I can’t kill him either."

"This Lin Yuan isn’t even thirteenth tier yet, and his power is so formidable? A direct fight is no less than us at the thirteenth tier."

"Unbelievable."

All the time lifeforms looked shocked.

On the timelines where they tried to kill Lin Yuan.

The best outcome was joining forces to force him out of the Chaos Void.

But very soon Lin Yuan killed his way back, and by then all seven time lifeforms in the Chaos Void faced extremely gruesome reckoning.

They were either completely suppressed, fled the Chaos Void in panic, never daring to return, or there was even a slight possibility of directly falling.

"Monster."

"What kind of monster is this."

The seven time lifeforms, including ’Lord Mo Xu,’ who was the first to discover Lin Yuan, all had looks of horror.

...

Chaos Void.

Desolate Void.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, with a small portion of his mind continuing to observe his future timeline.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan’s expression changed slightly.

In the dozens of future timelines he recently observed, more than 90% would soon become blurred and twisted.

This phenomenon should be due to some contact with a thirteenth-tier time lifeform.

"Is it highly likely that a thirteenth-tier time lifeform will want to see me next?"

Lin Yuan came to a conclusion.

There are countless variables in the future, but after reaching a certain time point or after a certain event occurs, some possibility will significantly increase.

For example, the original outcome for any peerless Great Saint in the Chaos Void could be to impact the thirteenth tier, only to immediately fall into a time loop.

The greatest possibility is this outcome, with more than 99,900 out of 100,000 timelines reaching this conclusion.

But when Lin Yuan harbored a killing intent towards this peerless Great Saint and wanted to strike, the future of this peerless Great Saint was almost certain.

Ten thousand future timelines, a million future timelines, billions of future timelines, would all meet the same end.

That is dying at the hands of Lin Yuan.

And now.

Lin Yuan, however, observed that the possibility of him encountering a time lifeform next rose significantly.

This does not match the timelines previously observed.

That is to say, something must have happened during that time, causing the time lifeforms to take notice of him.

"What on earth could it be?"

Lin Yuan fell into thought.

At the same time, he also began to examine himself.

He quickly discovered the red-dressed girl spirit in his inner universe looking somewhat uneasy.

"Master."

The red-dressed girl spirit, the Spirit of Jade Gourd, was nervously surveying her surroundings.

"What’s the matter?"

Lin Yuan asked.

"Master."

The red-dressed girl hesitated for a while, then honestly said, "I just sensed that the old master has awakened and wants to summon me over."

"Old master?"

Lin Yuan immediately had a clear understanding.

The old master of the red-dressed girl is the founder of the Infinite Void inheritance, a time lifeform of this Chaos Void.

"Then why don’t you go over?" Lin Yuan asked.

"Master, it’s not that I don’t want to go over, but I simply can’t get out," the red-dressed girl said helplessly.

This inner universe’s level of perfection surpasses the Chaos Void. Even though its size cannot match the latter, the internal and external isolation is almost absolute. Not to mention it can’t get out, even the old master would probably find it difficult to sense where it is.

"So that’s how it is."

Lin Yuan linked it to the possibility of encountering time lifeforms next, and his expression showed some contemplation.
